name: Sichuan Gold Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Gold Co., Ltd. engages in the gold mining business. The company offers mineral products and mining machinery, and consulting and after-sales services for mineral and engineering geology, and geological exploration. It also provides gold concentrate powder and alloy gold. The company was formerly known as Sichuan Rongda Gold Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sichuan Gold Co., Ltd. in May 2024. Sichuan Gold Co., Ltd. was founded in 2006 and is based in Chengdu, China.
